note: Recorded generation response used offline (no token). Target IS the mocked return value, so no expected value can depend on an unknown real value; SEN-002/003/004/005 oracles come from the SDD text.

scenarios.title: dependency error returns SENSOR_ERROR and is called once

oracle.statement: On dependency error the function returns SENSOR_ERROR.
oracle.rationale: SEN-002 states SENSOR_ERROR on a nonzero dependency status.

scenarios.title: in-range reading is stored and accepted

oracle.statement: On success with reading <= 1000 the reading is stored and SENSOR_OK returned.
oracle.rationale: SEN-003 states the stored value and SENSOR_OK.

scenarios.title: out-of-range reading is rejected without updating state

cases.note: reading > 1000 -> out of range, no store

oracle.statement: On success with reading > 1000 the function returns SENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.
oracle.rationale: SEN-004 states SENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE for readings above 1000.

omitted.reason: SEN-005 (recovery after an error) needs a two-call sequence; covered by the state-machine/mocked-sensor manual acceptance run rather than a single-call generated case.
